fields.title: 0. Changes since the previous edition
fields.md:
What this edition confirmed is that **oral argument was held as scheduled, and no ruling has been issued yet**. With no ruling or settlement, E-2028-1, R5, the probabilities and the assumed value band do not move. The table below is the full list of changes.

| Item | Previous edition (2026-11-10-event) | This edition | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| James case oral argument | '10-Q states it is scheduled for 2026-11-03' | **Held on 2026-11-03** (the 10-Q text also says 'was held') — the previous edition's 'scheduled' wording was a misreading | [10-Q R31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R31.htm) · [OPB](https://www.opb.org/article/2026/11/04/wildfire-survivors-lawsuit-utility-company-fire-oregon/) 2026-11-05 |
| Oregon Supreme Court ruling | Pending | Pending — reports say 'written ruling within months' | [KLCC](https://www.klcc.org/crime-law-justice/2026-11-05/oregon-supreme-court-pacificorp-wildfire-lawsuit-arguments) 2026-11-05 |
| New PacifiCorp settlement | — | No new settlement reported in 2026-11 (based on search; the last major settlement was the federal government's $575 million in 2026-02) | [WTOP/AP](https://wtop.com/national/2026/02/pacificorp-to-pay-575m-to-resolve-federal-governments-claims-over-wildfires-in-oregon-california/) |
| New SEC filings (since previous edition) | — | None — the latest are the 424B5, 8-K and 10-Q of 2026-11-09 | [EDGAR filing list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001067983&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=20) |
| Class B share price on 2026-11-09 | $574.76 | **$575.25 (close)** — the previous value appears to have been a pre-close figure (estimate) | [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/) |
| Scenario probabilities | 25/50/25 | Unchanged — none of R1–R6 is met | Section 3 below |
